name: strata-space
description: Plugins published by Strata (strata.space) for Claude Code.

plugins.name: strata
plugins.description: Keep Strata Spaces in live two-way sync as local Markdown folders, and work with your Strata documents in conversation through the bundled MCP server: research with citations, publish local content, review with comments, and diagnose connectivity.

plugins.name: strata-memory
plugins.description: Turn a Strata Space into your coding agent's long-term memory: hybrid-search recall on every prompt, a sourced-fact update contract, and a stop-time nudge so the agent keeps its own memory current. Works in Claude Code and Codex; requires the strata CLI.
